saf1.planning_tip: Book SANParks rest camps online for self-drive, or compare private concessions on the park edge.

saf2.planning_tip: Mokoro trips are arranged through Maun operators or Delta lodges — fly-in camps include transfers.

saf3.planning_tip: Stay inside Etosha gates for waterhole access — NWR camps book months ahead in peak season.

saf4.planning_tip: Hwange lodges and self-catering camps sit near Main Camp — compare guided drives vs self-drive.

saf5.planning_tip: Gorongosa is best reached via Beira or Chimoio — book drives through the park directly.

saf6.planning_tip: Liwonde boat safaris depart from Mvuu Camp area — combine with Lake Malawi shoreline stays.

saf7.planning_tip: Hlane is run by Big Game Parks — guided drives are mandatory; book through their central office.

saf8.planning_tip: Walking safaris require licensed operators in South Luangwa — dry season offers best walking conditions.

adv1.planning_tip: Sandboarding operators base in Swakopmund and Walvis Bay — half-day trips run year-round.

adv2.planning_tip: Rafting below Victoria Falls runs when water is low enough — compare Zambia vs Zimbabwe operators.

adv3.planning_tip: Tofo operators run whale-shark snorkel trips in season — check Cabo Delgado travel advisories.

adv4.planning_tip: Sani Pass requires 4x4 and a Lesotho border crossing — guided tours depart from Underberg.

adv5.planning_tip: Kayak trails run from Cape Maclear and other lakeshore villages — hire gear locally.

adv6.planning_tip: Malolotja canopy tour books through the nature reserve — combine with highland hiking.

adv7.planning_tip: Chobe river activities base in Kasane — book boat or kayak trips with licensed operators.

cul1.planning_tip: Choose community-run Himba experiences near Opuwo — avoid unsolicited roadside photo stops.

cul2.planning_tip: Stellenbosch and Franschhoek estates offer tastings by appointment — designate a driver or use transfers.

cul3.planning_tip: Great Zimbabwe is a day trip from Masvingo — hire a local guide at the UNESCO site entrance.

cul4.planning_tip: Maputo food tours focus on the fish market and downtown — use registered guides after dark.

cul5.planning_tip: Community homestays on Lake Malawi book through village tourism committees — bring cash for hosts.

cul6.planning_tip: Pony treks from Malealea or Semonkong include guides and pack animals — book a day ahead.

cul7.planning_tip: Swazi craft studios cluster in the Ezulwini Valley — combine with a cultural village visit.

cul8.planning_tip: Livingstone Island trips run from the Zambian side in low-water season — book through licensed operators.

nat1.planning_tip: Helicopter flights over the Falls book from Livingstone or Victoria Falls town — morning flights have clearer views.

nat2.planning_tip: Amphitheatre hikes start from Royal Natal or Sentinel car park — use a registered mountain guide.

nat3.planning_tip: Meerkat experiences run from lodges near Ntwetwe Pan — dry season (Apr–Sep) is most reliable.

nat4.planning_tip: Bazaruto trips launch from Vilankulo or Inhassoro — check marine park fees and island lodge transfers.

nat5.planning_tip: Snorkelling is best from Cape Maclear and Otter Point — hire mask and fins from lakeshore lodges.

nat6.planning_tip: Nyika access is from the Chelinda or Livingstonia side — 4x4 recommended in wet season.

nat7.planning_tip: Balloon flights over Sossusvlei launch near Sesriem — book well ahead in peak season.

nat8.planning_tip: Mana Pools canoe trails need licensed guides and park permits — book months ahead in peak season.
